enchantments.tooltip: Fire Lore +16: Passive: Your Fire spells gain a +16% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Combustion +111: Passive: +111 Equipment bonus to Fire Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +6: +6 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Fire Absorption +27%: Passive: 27% Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)

Wand Maximizing: Spells cast from this wand are treated as though they were Maximized, dealing 100% more damage than they normally would. This damage increase does not stack with bonuses granted by enhancements.
